title: Quantara: edge-first fleet protection

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(ts) AS time, (payload->'edge_counters'->>'edge_resolved')::float AS edge_resolved, (payload->'edge_counters'->>'escalated')::float AS escalated FROM events WHERE topic='cloud.fleet' AND kind='feeds' AND $__timeFilter(to_timestamp(ts)) ORDER BY ts

SELECT to_timestamp(ts) AS time, (payload->'edge_counters'->>'bytes_saved')::float AS bytes_saved, (payload->'edge_counters'->>'bytes_sent')::float AS bytes_sent FROM events WHERE topic='cloud.fleet' AND kind='feeds' AND $__timeFilter(to_timestamp(ts)) ORDER BY ts
SELECT payload->'incident'->>'cause' AS cause, count(*) AS n FROM events WHERE topic IN ('cloud.escalations','cloud.security') AND $__timeFilter(to_timestamp(ts)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT r AS reason, count(*) AS n FROM events, jsonb_array_elements_text(payload->'reasons') r WHERE topic IN ('cloud.escalations','cloud.security') AND $__timeFilter(to_timestamp(ts)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
SELECT payload->>'final_cause' AS cause, count(*) AS n FROM events WHERE topic='cloud.twin' AND $__timeFilter(to_timestamp(ts)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT date_trunc('minute', to_timestamp(ts)) AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE topic='commands.out') AS issued, count(*) FILTER (WHERE topic='notify.out' AND kind='refused') AS refused FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(to_timestamp(ts)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Rollouts: applied vs failed (latest status per rollout)

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (payload->>'id') payload->>'id' AS rollout, payload->>'status' AS status, (payload->>'pct')::int AS pct, (payload->>'applied')::int AS applied, (payload->>'failed')::int AS failed, (payload->>'skipped_no_consent')::int AS skipped FROM events WHERE kind='rollout_status' ORDER BY payload->>'id', id DESC

SELECT date_trunc('minute', to_timestamp(ts)) AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE topic='dlq') AS dlq, count(*) FILTER (WHERE topic='quarantine') AS quarantine FROM events WHERE $__timeFilter(to_timestamp(ts)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT to_timestamp(ts) AS time, seq, actor, action, detail FROM audit ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT to_timestamp(ts) AS time, (vss->>'Vehicle.Speed')::float AS "Vehicle.Speed" FROM telemetry WHERE vehicle_id='${vehicle}' AND $__timeFilter(to_timestamp(ts)) ORDER BY ts
SELECT to_timestamp(ts) AS time, (vss->>'Vehicle.Chassis.Axle.Row1.Wheel.Left.Speed')::float AS "FL" FROM telemetry WHERE vehicle_id='${vehicle}' AND $__timeFilter(to_timestamp(ts)) ORDER BY ts

SELECT to_timestamp(ts) AS time, (vss->>'Vehicle.Acceleration.Vertical')::float AS "vertical (bumps)" FROM telemetry WHERE vehicle_id='${vehicle}' AND $__timeFilter(to_timestamp(ts)) ORDER BY ts

SELECT to_timestamp(ts) AS time, (vss->>'Vehicle.Chassis.Axle.Row1.Wheel.Left.Suspension.Travel')::float AS "FL" FROM telemetry WHERE vehicle_id='${vehicle}' AND $__timeFilter(to_timestamp(ts)) ORDER BY ts

SELECT to_timestamp(ts) AS time, (vss->>'Vehicle.Chassis.Axle.Row1.Wheel.Right.Suspension.Travel')::float AS "FR" FROM telemetry WHERE vehicle_id='${vehicle}' AND $__timeFilter(to_timestamp(ts)) ORDER BY ts

SELECT to_timestamp(ts) AS time, (vss->>'Vehicle.Chassis.Axle.Row2.Wheel.Left.Suspension.Travel')::float AS "RL" FROM telemetry WHERE vehicle_id='${vehicle}' AND $__timeFilter(to_timestamp(ts)) ORDER BY ts

SELECT to_timestamp(ts) AS time, (vss->>'Vehicle.Chassis.SteeringWheel.Angle')::float AS "Vehicle.Chassis.SteeringWheel.Angle" FROM telemetry WHERE vehicle_id='${vehicle}' AND $__timeFilter(to_timestamp(ts)) ORDER BY ts

SELECT to_timestamp(ts) AS time, (vss->>'Vehicle.Powertrain.TractionBattery.Temperature.Average')::float AS "temp °C" FROM telemetry WHERE vehicle_id='${vehicle}' AND $__timeFilter(to_timestamp(ts)) ORDER BY ts
